segments.an8.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
segments.an8.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
segments.an8.10:1.3: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññenāññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
segments.an8.10:2.5: Kiṃ vo tena paraputtena visodhitena [kiṃ voparaputto viheṭhiyati (sī.), kiṃ paraputto viheṭheti (syā.), kiṃ vo paraputtā viheṭheti (pī.), kiṃ so paraputto visodheti (ka.)]!
segments.an8.10:2.6: Idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃyeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ samiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ, seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ – yāvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ na passanti.
segments.an8.10:2.8: Yato ca khvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti, tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti –
segments.an8.10:3.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, sampanne yavakaraṇe yavadūsī [yavarūpī (ka.)] jāyetha yavapalāpo yavakāraṇḍavoti.
segments.an8.10:3.2: Tassa tādisaṃyeva mūlaṃ hoti, seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ;
segments.an8.10:3.3: tādisaṃyeva nāḷaṃ hoti, seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ;
segments.an8.10:3.4: tādisaṃyeva pattaṃ hoti, seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ – yāvassa sīsaṃ na nibbattati.
segments.an8.10:3.6: Yato ca khvassa sīsaṃ nibbattati, tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti –
segments.an8.10:3.8: Tamenaṃ iti viditvā samūlaṃ uppāṭetvā bahiddhā yavakaraṇassa chaḍḍenti.
segments.an8.10:4.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idhekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃyeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ samiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ, seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ – yāvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ na passanti.
segments.an8.10:4.3: Yato ca khvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti, tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti –
segments.an8.10:5.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, mahato dhaññarāsissa phuṇamānassa [vuyhamānassa (sī. pī.), phusayamānassa (syā.), punamānassa (?)] tattha yāni tāni dhaññāni daḷhāni sāravantāni tāni ekamantaṃ puñjaṃ hoti, yāni pana tāni dhaññāni dubbalāni palāpāni tāni vāto ekamantaṃ apavahati [apakassati (sī.)].
segments.an8.10:5.2: Tamenaṃ sāmikā sammajjaniṃ gahetvā bhiyyosomattāya apasammajjanti.
segments.an8.10:5.5: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idhekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃyeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ samiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ, seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ – yāvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ na passanti.
segments.an8.10:5.7: Yato ca khvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti, tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti –
segments.an8.10:6.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso udapānapanāḷiyatthiko tiṇhaṃ kuṭhāriṃ [kudhāriṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya.
segments.an8.10:6.2: So yaṃ yadeva rukkhaṃ kuṭhāripāsena ākoṭeyya tattha yāni tāni rukkhāni daḷhāni sāravantāni tāni kuṭhāripāsena ākoṭitāni kakkhaḷaṃ paṭinadanti;
segments.an8.10:6.3: yāni pana tāni rukkhāni antopūtīni avassutāni kasambujātāni tāni kuṭhāripāsena ākoṭitāni daddaraṃ paṭinadanti.
segments.an8.10:6.4: Tamenaṃ mūle chindati, mūle chinditvā agge chindati, agge chinditvā anto suvisodhitaṃ visodheti, anto suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā udapānapanāḷiṃ yojeti.
segments.an8.10:6.5: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idhekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃyeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ samiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ, seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ – yāvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ na passanti.
segments.an8.10:6.7: Yato ca khvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti, tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti –
segments.an8.10:7.3: Makkhī thambhī paḷāsī ca, issukī maccharī saṭho.
segments.an8.10:10.1: “Kāraṇḍavaṃ [karaṇḍavaṃ (ka.) su. ni.283 passitabbaṃ] niddhamatha, kasambuṃ apakassatha [avakassatha (ka.)];
segments.an8.10:12.1: Mettaṃ paññā ca dve piyā, dve lokā dve vipattiyo;
segments.an8.10:12.3: Devadatto ca uttaro, nando kāraṇḍavena cāti.

lines: Dasame aññenāññaṃ paṭicaratīti aññena kāraṇena vacanena vā aññaṃ kāraṇaṃ vacanaṃ vā paṭicchādeti.
Bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmetīti bāhirato aññaṃ āgantukakathaṃ otāreti.
Samaṇapalāpoti vīhīsu vīhipalāpo viya nissāratāya samaṇesu samaṇapalāpo.
Apasammajjantīti sāradhaññānaṃ ekato dubbaladhaññānaṃ ekato karaṇatthaṃ punappunaṃ apasammajjanti, apasammajjanisaṅkhātena vātaggāhinā suppena vā vatthena vā nīharanti.
Raho karoti karaṇanti karaṇaṃ vuccati pāpakammaṃ, taṃ raho paṭicchanno hutvā karoti.
Saṃsappī ca musāvādīti saṃsappitvā musāvādī, musā bhaṇanto saṃsappati phandatīti attho.
Imasmiṃ sutte vaṭṭameva kathetvā gāthāsu vaṭṭavivaṭṭaṃ kathitanti.
Paṭicchādanaṭṭho eva vā carati-saddo anekatthattā dhātūnanti āha “paṭicchādetī”ti.
Tattha aññaṃ kāraṇaṃ vacanaṃ vāti yaṃ codakena cuditakassa dosavibhāvanaṃ kāraṇaṃ, vacanaṃ vā vuttaṃ, taṃ tato aññeneva kāraṇena, vacanena vā paṭicchādeti.

Yo hi “āpattiṃ āpannosī”ti vutto “ko āpanno, kiṃ āpanno, kismiṃ āpannā, kaṃ bhaṇatha, kiṃ bhaṇathā”ti vā vadati,“evarūpaṃ kiñci tayā diṭṭhan”ti vutte “na suṇāmī”ti sotaṃ vā upaneti, ayaṃ aññenāññaṃ paṭicarati nāma.
Yo pana “itthannāmaṃ nāma āpattiṃ āpannosī”ti puṭṭho “pāṭaliputtaṃ gatomhī”ti vatvā puna “na tava pāṭaliputtagamanaṃ pucchāma, āpattiṃ pucchāmā”ti vutte tato “rājagahaṃ gatomhi.
Rājagahaṃ vā yāhi brāhmaṇagahaṃ vā, āpattiṃ āpannosīti.
Taṃ tattha me sūkaramaṃsaṃ laddhan”tiādīni vadati, ayaṃ bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti nāma.
Kāraṇḍavaṃ (su. ni. aṭṭha.2.283-284) niddhamathāti vipannasīlatāya kacavarabhūtaṃ puggalaṃ kacavaramiva anapekkhā apanetha.
Kasambuṃ apakassathāti kasambubhūtañca naṃ khattiyādīnaṃ majjhagataṃ pabhinnapaggharitakuṭṭhaṃ caṇḍālaṃ viya apakaḍḍhatha.
Saṅghārāmo nāma sīlavantānaṃ kato, na dussīlānaṃ.
Yato etadeva sandhāyāha “tato palāpe vāhetha, assamaṇe samaṇamānine”ti.
Yathā palāpā antosārarahitā ataṇḍulā bahi thusena vīhī viya dissanti, evaṃ pāpabhikkhū anto sīlarahitāpi bahi kāsāvādiparikkhārena bhikkhū viya dissanti, tasmā “palāpā”ti vuccanti.
Te palāpe vāhetha opunatha vidhamatha, paramatthato assamaṇe samaṇavesamattena samaṇamānine.
Vaṭṭadukkhassa antaṃ karissatha, parinibbānaṃ pāpuṇissathāti attho.
